blocks.html:
Step-by-Step Guide to Buying a Home in Northern Colorado

Ready to buy a home in Larimer or Weld County? Whether you're relocating, upgrading, or buying your first home, this guide walks you through the entire process — from pre-approval to move-in day.

Common Questions Answered:

  • How much money do I need to buy a house in Northern Colorado?
  • What credit score do I need to qualify?
  • What’s the first step to buying a house?
  • Are there down payment assistance programs in Weld or Larimer County?
  • Can I buy a house without 20% down?

The Home Buying Process

1. Get Pre-Approved for a Mortgage

Start with a trusted lender who can determine your budget and provide a pre-approval letter. This shows sellers you’re serious and ready to go.

2. Set Your Budget & Search Smart

Consider monthly payments, taxes, HOA fees, and location. Use my local home search or ask about off-market options!

3. Tour Homes & Ask Questions

I’ll guide you through showings, compare properties, and point out things you might miss — from zoning to future resale potential.

4. Make a Competitive Offer

We’ll write an offer that gives you the edge — not just on price, but terms, timing, and protections.

5. Go Under Contract & Schedule Inspections

Once accepted, we’ll do a full inspection, negotiate repairs, and start title, insurance, and loan paperwork.

6. Appraisal, Final Loan Approval & Walkthrough

We’ll stay in close contact with your lender, ensure any loan conditions are cleared, and confirm the home’s value before closing.

7. Closing Day!

Sign, wire funds, receive your keys, and take a deep breath — you did it!

Work with me and get $500 toward closing costs on your next home.
